title: Fix client Railway build
description: Client service was using root railway.json (server's build config) and failing on corepack signature verification. Plan: create per-service client/railway.json + set rootDirectory=client + point client service config path at client/railway.json.
close_reason: Fixed client deploy. Root cause: client service was reading the SHARED root /railway.json which contains the server's build/start commands, regardless of railwayConfigFile or rootDirectory overrides on the service. railway up from repo root always includes / railway.json in the build context. Working fix: (1) set buildCommand='npm install --include=dev && npm run build' and startCommand='npx serve -s dist -l $PORT --no-clipboard' directly on the client service via GraphQL serviceInstanceUpdate, (2) deploy with 'railway up ./client --path-as-root --service client' so only the client/ subdir becomes the build context (no stray /railway.json). HTTP 200 confirmed at poke-sniper.up.railway.app.

title: Diagnose & fix Railway build failures
description: Railway builds for the server have been failing. Recent commit 8e034cd was a build fix (prisma move to dependencies). Need to fetch the actual failing build log via Railway CLI/MCP, identify the first error, and apply a targeted fix per the plan at ~/.claude/plans/we-need-to-continue-snoopy-reddy.md
close_reason: Fixed by 6e5866d. Root cause: Railway sets NODE_ENV=production on the server service, so pnpm install skipped devDependencies. Build then failed first on prisma (fixed 8e034cd), then tsc (fixed 8a51aef), then @types/node. Final fix: in railway.json buildCommand, prefix install with NODE_ENV=development and use --force so devDeps are reinstalled over the Nixpacks step-7 prod-only install. Deploy succeeded, server running on port 8080.

title: feat(server): name-based supersession in lot revaluation
description: Lift reValueWithAnnotation from server/src/routes/lots.ts (line 561) into server/src/services/lotValuation.ts next to valueLot. Change logic to recompute autoLow/autoHigh from Lot.parsedCards JSON instead of reading the cached scalars, dropping any parsed entry whose name (case-insensitive trim) matches the Card.name of a user-added card. Avoids double-counting when the user picks the correct printing of a card the AI already auto-resolved (e.g. Mew Vmax base + user picks Mew Vmax Fusion Strike Alt Art). No schema change. See plan: ~/.claude/plans/we-need-to-continue-snoopy-reddy.md
close_reason: Lifted reValueWithAnnotation + bestSingleMarket from routes/lots.ts to services/lotValuation.ts. Prevents double-counting when user picks the correct printing of a card the AI already auto-resolved. 194/194 server tests still passing. Commit e19421a.
